hypotheses.claim: In attribute_effect, the trailing select effect calls select_option(select, prev.value) without mounting=true; when the spread has no 'value', undefined matches no option and selectedIndex is set to -1, wiping the selected-attribute default.
hypotheses.prediction: Passing mounting=true (as upstream does) preserves the HTML selected default when no value prop exists, and only spread selects are affected (control select has no attribute_effect).
hypotheses.falsifier: If the value is applied before options exist or timing is the issue, mounting=true will still leave selects[1].value empty.

hypotheses.claim: The bug is in set_attributes resetting select state, not the follow-up effect.
hypotheses.prediction: The failure would occur even if the trailing effect were removed entirely.
hypotheses.falsifier: Removing the trailing select effect would fix the repro; if it doesn't, set_attributes is at fault.
